subject: Novum renewal: usage decomposition and expansion scenarios
messages:
From: Elaine Santos <elaine@novum.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal check-in: usage breakdown & scaling options

Hi Jonas,

We’re starting internal planning for our contract renewal and want to understand the usage trend for the last 6 months and options to scale for two new features we plan to ship in Q1. High level: current monthly token spend has crept from ~120M to ~220M over the last three quarters due to an added summarization pipeline and higher temperature sampling.

Can you share a short ROI recap (latency impact, cost per 1M tokens, and recommended commitment options) and a couple of practical expansion scenarios we could evaluate? Procurement will expect an outline we can attach to the PO.

Also, if there are quick performance wins (batching tweaks, model variant suggestions) that would help reduce short-term burn, please call them out.

Thanks,
Elaine Santos
Head of Product
Novum AI

---
Attachments referenced: none
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Elaine Santos <elaine@novum.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-02T14:08:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in: usage breakdown & scaling options

Hi Elaine — thanks for the note and context. Looping in Karthik and Grace to confirm ops/SLAs and to draft a couple of commitment scenarios.

Quick snapshot we pulled from the last 180 days:
- Token mix: 68% generation (chat+summaries), 22% embeddings, 10% re-ranking
- 90th p95 latency on prod model: 180ms (stable), occasional tail to ~420ms during peak bursts
- Effective blended cost to you (current mix, post-discounts): ~$0.88 per 1k tokens (we'll show per model breakdown in the report)

I’ll attach a cleaned token export and a short exec summary so you can forward to procurement. We’ll propose 3 scenarios (conservative / growth / aggressive) with committed token tiers, unit price movement, and burst credits.

If you want short-term burn relief while we finalize the renewal: we can try a 30-day prefix cache on the summarization pipeline that often reduces repeated prompt tokens by 12–18%. That’s a low-friction change we can stand up from our side.

Sending the export and a draft proposal by Thursday EOD.

—Jonas
VP, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: novum_token_report_q4.csv, redwood_exec_summary_novum.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-03T07:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal check-in: usage breakdown & scaling options (internal)

Thanks — quick internal read from infra/opt:
- Recommend measuring prefix cache improvement on a 2-week A/B split (baseline vs cache) to validate the 12–18% token saving claim. Ops estimate: ~3–5 dev days to instrument + 1 week to gather sig data.
- For committed tiers, offer a quantized model variant (same quality for summaries, ~20% lower unit-cost CPU/GPU footprint) as a lower-price tier; tie it to traffic routed at 10–30% initially.
- SLA note: growth/aggressive tiers need burst-capacity reservation to avoid tail latency spikes; add a 99.9% P95 target with a 30% burst corridor in the proposal.

I’ll draft the commit math (price per 1M tokens by tier) and a quick ops checklist.

-Karthik
Director, Platform Performance

No attachments.
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
To: Elaine Santos <elaine@novum.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-11-08T11:40:00Z
Subject: Novum renewal: proposed scenarios and next steps

Hi Elaine — attached is a short proposal and three expansion scenarios (Conservative / Growth / Aggressive). Summary below so procurement can triage quickly. I’ve included a HubSpot link and a Drive folder with the token export and the full economics sheet.

Scenario summaries (monthly committed tokens / indicative unit price / burst credits):
- Conservative: 300M committed / $0.76 per 1M tokens / 5% burst credits
- Growth: 500M committed / $0.62 per 1M tokens / 12% burst credits + 30-day pilot for prefix caching
- Aggressive: 900M committed / $0.48 per 1M tokens / 20% burst credits + quantized-model deployment for summaries

ROI notes: based on current mix, Growth unlocks ~21% unit cost reduction vs today and preserves latency SLOs with reserved capacity. Aggressive improves unit cost materially but requires a 4-week staged rollout to validate model-mix and routing.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Sign off on scenario (Elaine) — select conservative/growth/aggressive by Nov 17
2) Pilot: prefix cache A/B (2 weeks of analysis) if Growth is chosen (Redwood instruments)
3) PO issued and signature — target Nov 30
4) Staged rollout & capacity reservation — target go-live Jan 10

I attached commit_scenarios_v2.xlsx and the short exec summary. Open to a quick 30-minute call to walk procurement through the options.

Best,
Jonas Weber
VP, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: commit_scenarios_v2.xlsx, redwood_exec_summary_novum.pdf
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/83421
From: Elaine Santos <elaine@novum.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alan Choi <alan.choi@novum.ai>
Date: 2028-11-15T16:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Novum renewal: proposed scenarios and next steps

Jonas — thanks for the clear breakdown and the scenarios. We’ve reviewed internally and would like to move forward with the Growth scenario, subject to a short pilot and standard Novum procurement terms. Alan from procurement is on copy to coordinate the PO and PO template.

Next steps on our side:
- Alan will share a draft PO and ASN within 48 hours
- We approve the 30-day prefix-cache pilot (please confirm instrumentation plan and required contacts)
- If pilot shows >=10% token reduction, we’ll proceed to sign the Growth commitment target (500M / month) and target Nov 30 for PO signature.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please route the pilot onboarding notes to alan.choi@novum.ai and cc me.

Best,
Elaine Santos
Head of Product
Novum AI
